comments.body: Hello there, thank you for opening an PR ! 🙏🏻 The team was notified and they will get back to you asap.

Thanks for catching the retired default. Please change three things:

1. **Use `DEFAULT_MODEL_NAME` instead of `"gpt-5.6-sol"`.** Every other agent in the repo defaults to `DEFAULT_MODEL_NAME`. Point `AgentJudge`, `ReflexionAgent`, `KnowledgeGenerator`, `Reasoner` and `GKPAgent` at it too, so the next model change happens in one place. Update the `AgentJudge` docstring example to match, and make the test assert `== DEFAULT_MODEL_NAME`.
2. **Cut the 2-line comment** above `RETIRED_DEFAULT_MODEL` in `tests/agents/test_default_agent_models.py` to one line, per CLAUDE.md.
3. **Docs:** since the docs repo doesn't take outside PRs, open an issue on The-Swarm-Corporation/swarms-framework-docs listing the pages that show `"openai/o1"` as the default (`agents/agent-judge.mdx`, `agents/reflexion-agent.mdx`, `agents/gkp-agent.mdx`), and link it from this PR.

Done in 211286f: the five classes now default to `DEFAULT_MODEL_NAME` (from `swarms.agents.llm_manager`, currently `gpt-5.4`), the AgentJudge docstring example matches, the test asserts `== DEFAULT_MODEL_NAME`, and the comment is one line. swarms-framework-docs is limited to collaborators (issue creation is restricted there), so the doc pages that still show `openai/o1` are listed in the PR description. PR title and description updated.

This comment was drafted with an AI agent (Claude) working for the PR author.

Thanks for switching the five defaults to `DEFAULT_MODEL_NAME`. The code change is good to go.

Please delete the new test file, `tests/agents/test_default_agent_models.py`. Keep the PR to the changes in `agent_judge.py`, `flexion_agent.py` and `gkp_agent.py`, and I'll merge it.

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code) (Claude Opus 5.5)

Done in 833a909: `tests/agents/test_default_agent_models.py` is removed, so the PR now only changes `agent_judge`, `flexion_agent` and `gkp_agent`.

This comment was drafted with Claude Code.
